Dried biosolids are hauled off-site for disposal, reuse, or further treatment prior to reuse.

Undisinfected, secondary-treated wastewater is discharged to the on-site disposal ponds. Currently, there are eight unlined, on-site disposal ponds with a total surface area of approximately 23.24 acres and a total storage capacity of approximately 139.4 acre-feet (45.4 million gallons).
